posts.author: marclou
posts.text:
I'm adding @Razorpay to TrustMRR, and I need your help.

If you've made $1,000 on Razorpay and want to join TrustMRR, please send me a DM.

I'll manually build the public revenue page for your startup so I can test the Razorpay API with real API keys. Thanks!
posts.text_zh:
我要把 @Razorpay 加进 TrustMRR，需要你的帮助。

如果你在 Razorpay 上做过 $1,000，又想加入 TrustMRR，请私信我。

我会手动给你的创业项目搭公开营收页，好用真实 API key 测 Razorpay API。谢谢！

posts.author: marclou
posts.text:
It took me:

- 2 years to make $1 online
- 8 months to get 1,000 followers 
- 3 months to grow a SaaS to $1k MRR

I’ve built 43 startups and posted 38.7K tweets.

It takes time. 

Whoever pretends otherwise is trying to sell you a get-rich-quick dream.
posts.text_zh:
我花了：

- 2 年才在网上赚到第 1 美元
- 8 个月才涨到 1,000 粉丝
- 3 个月才把一个 SaaS 做到 $1k MRR

我已经做过 43 个创业项目，发过 38.7K 条推文。

这需要时间。

谁假装不是这样，多半是在向你兜售暴富速成梦。
posts.quote_note: 引用 @gregisenberg：提醒创始人，现在外面有大量虚报的 ARR 数字。

posts.author: steipete
posts.text:
Bullish on Andy Yen and Proton. He gets it.

The culture war, or rather the loss of identity some engineers feel as AI redefines our jobs is difficult; I sympathize. Also understand that he runs a business and might has limited patience when we now had two years to process, learn, change and grow.
posts.text_zh:
看好 Andy Yen 和 Proton。他懂行。

文化战争，或者说部分工程师在 AI 重塑我们工作时感到的身份失落，确实很难；我同情。也理解他要经营公司——我们已经有两年时间去消化、学习、改变和成长，他的耐心可能有限。
posts.quote_note: 引用他人晒出的 Proton CTO（Andy Yen 相关）AI 宣言（AI manifesto）。
